metadata.purpose: Blacklist for 27.2.1 diff analysis — skip ALL listed patterns, CVEs, subsystems, and techniques

KASLR_info_leak.why_dead: Apple zeroes kaddr returns, property dictionaries contain no kernel pointers, IOSurfaceGetBaseAddress returns userspace pixel buffer
KASLR_info_leak.kill_mechanism: Systematic kernel pointer scrubbing in all userspace-facing APIs
KASLR_info_leak.note: KASLR solved via timing oracle v4.1 (z=7.67) — info leak paths are irrelevant

GPU_Metal.why_dead: DART isolates GPU VA from kernel PA. UAT completely blocks GPU access to kernel memory. DART page tables are in kernel memory, not GPU VA space.
GPU_Metal.kill_mechanism: DART hardware isolation + UAT address space separation
GPU_Metal.note: F1OOB cross-object OOB works 100% in userland but cannot escape to kernel

IOSurface_overflow.why_dead: Kernel rejects compressionType=3 variants (e00002c2), clamps sliceCount=1 internally
IOSurface_overflow.kill_mechanism: Kernel-side input validation and internal clamping

AVE_video_encoder.why_dead: DART/IOMMU protects DMA, type isolation separates zones, AppleAVE2 has binary-confirmed bounds checks, VT userspace clamps temporal layers
AVE_video_encoder.kill_mechanism: DART isolation + DPB bounds checks at 0x86d0338 and 0x86d46f0 + VT user-space NTL clamp + kernel cmp w8,#9;b.hs at 0x872b100

AVC_video_codec.why_dead: VT userspace validates log2_max range: log2_fn>16 → -12911, poc_lsb>16 → -12710. AppleAVE2 kernel checks are defense-in-depth only.
AVC_video_codec.kill_mechanism: VideoToolbox userspace validates SPS range before kernel sees values

IPC_Mach_port.why_dead: Table grows ONCE (64→128). After single grow, freelist has 48+ free entries. ipc_port_request_grow() NEVER called again. No race window.
IPC_Mach_port.kill_mechanism: Grow-once design: freelist prevents subsequent growth, eliminating race window

device_tests.ipcfuzz: 10000 ops × 4 threads, 0 panic, bounded not a write PoC

ANE_neural_engine.why_dead: Mutable weights buffer lives in aned daemon address space. App → CoreML → XPC → aned → IOKit. Direct IOKit returns kIOReturnNotPermitted.
ANE_neural_engine.kill_mechanism: Architectural sandbox barrier: aned daemon mediates all ANE kext access

device_tests.v2_ANEUpdateDiag: Training OK, 0 mutable weight headers, CPU-only

SPTM.why_dead: All require EL2/EL3 access or existing kernel compromise. Not reachable from userspace/sandbox.
SPTM.kill_mechanism: Requires privilege level we don't have (EL2/EL3 or existing kR/W)

IOMFB_display.why_dead: No IOMobileFrameBuffer kext in A18 Pro kernelcache. Fix is in DCP firmware, not kernel.
IOMFB_display.kill_mechanism: Component does not exist in kernelcache — DCP firmware side only

HandleRace_kRW_strategies.why_dead: Type isolation separates zones. No kernel pointers in IOSurface properties. IOKit selectors leak no kptrs. Notification UAF race timing too tight (0/200).
HandleRace_kRW_strategies.kill_mechanism: kalloc_type<IOSurface>.1024 isolated from kalloc_data — type isolation

external_references.why_dead: Targets iOS 18.6.2, requires ClearSword KRW we don't have
external_references.kill_mechanism: Wrong iOS version + depends on unavailable primitive

ScalerCSC.why_dead: ALL 12 selectors have scalarIn=0, NO struct input. Pure status/config reader with zero parsing surface. 2.99M fuzzes, 0 crashes.
ScalerCSC.kill_mechanism: No struct input = no memory corruption surface. Driver is pure getter class.

device_tests.selector_fuzz: 2.99M calls on sel11, 100% KERN_SUCCESS, fixed 664-byte output

dead_techniques.name: Heap spray cross-zone reclaim
dead_techniques.why_dead: Type Isolation in 27.0.1: kalloc_type<IOSurface>.1024 is separate from kalloc_data (OSData/pipe). No spray from one zone fills another.
dead_techniques.lesson: All successful iOS 16+ jailbreaks bypass type isolation by working at physical/VM/VFS level

dead_techniques.name: Fake object spray (OSData/pipe substitution)
dead_techniques.why_dead: Type isolation + zone sequestering. Cannot place controlled data in typed zone.

dead_techniques.name: GPU → kernel memory access
dead_techniques.why_dead: DART hardware + UAT isolation. GPU VA space completely separated from kernel VA.

dead_techniques.name: AVE/AVC bitstream field overflow
dead_techniques.why_dead: VideoToolbox userspace validates ALL bitstream parameters before kernel. Need separate VT vuln to bypass.

dead_techniques.name: Direct IOKit to hardware accelerators
dead_techniques.why_dead: XPC gating: aned, DCP, and other accelerator daemons mediate access. kIOReturnNotPermitted from sandbox.

dead_techniques.name: IPC request table race
dead_techniques.why_dead: Grow-once design with freelist. No second grow = no race window.

dead_techniques.name: IOSurface property/selector kernel pointer leak
dead_techniques.why_dead: Apple scrubs ALL kernel pointers from user-facing property dictionaries and IOKit method returns.

dead_techniques.name: CoW bypass via file truncation
dead_techniques.why_dead: Vulnerable vm_object state (external + no pager) unreachable from userspace. File-backed = vnode pager → SIGBUS. IOSurface = device_pager → handled.
dead_techniques.note: Exploitable only via kernel-internal object state manipulation — needs another primitive

unverified_leads.name: AVD-SHARED-BUFFER-LIFECYCLE
unverified_leads.why_promising: PAGE-LEVEL allocations via IOMemoryDescriptor BYPASS Type Isolation. Destroy-during-decode race → physical page UAF. Reachable via VideoToolbox from sandbox.
unverified_leads.next_step: Decompile methods #29-30, check synchronization primitives, look for missing lock around destroy

unverified_leads.name: JPEG-STRUCT-INPUT-2024
unverified_leads.why_promising: AppleJPEGDriverIOStruct2024 NEW in iOS 27. width*height overflow → DART maps fewer pages → codec DMA OOB. Reachable via ImageIO JPEG decode.
unverified_leads.next_step: Reverse IOStruct2024 layout, fuzz dimensions for integer overflow

unverified_leads.name: SEPKEYSTORE-DER-OOB
unverified_leads.why_promising: 27.2 adds 'device state der too big to cache' string ABSENT in 27.0.1. Heap buffer overflow from oversized DER blob.
unverified_leads.next_step: Test IOServiceOpen from app sandbox to see if reachable

exclusion_patterns: Skip ANY function diff in AppleAVE2 related to SPS/PPS/VPS/MMCO/DPB bounds checks — ALL are defense-in-depth behind VT userspace validation
Skip ANY IOSurface compressionType or sliceCount validation changes — kernel already clamps
Skip ANY mach_port_kobject or task_info pointer return changes — all scrubbed to 0
Skip ANY IORegistry property dictionary kernel pointer changes — systematically scrubbed
Skip ANY IPC port request table growth changes — grow-once architecture, no race
Skip ANY ANE/AppleH16ANEInterface symbolIndex or buffer mapping changes — unreachable from sandbox via aned XPC gate
Skip ANY IOMobileFrameBuffer changes — not in kernelcache, DCP firmware side
Skip ANY AppleM2ScalerCSCDriver changes — no struct input, no attack surface
Skip ANY GPU/AGX/DART PTE manipulation changes — hardware isolation, GPU cannot reach kernel
Skip diffs that only add logging, assertion strings, or telemetry (no behavioral change)
Skip CoW/vm_fault zero-fill changes UNLESS they introduce a NEW reachable path (not file truncation)
PRIORITIZE: IOMemoryDescriptor lifecycle (page-level, bypasses type isolation), new IOKit structs (2024+), DER/ASN.1 parsing, VFS/UPL layer, vm_map entry handling, Bluetooth/WiFi/USB kext changes

golden_rules.rule1_type_isolation: kalloc_type zones are separate from kalloc_data. No cross-zone spray works. Work at physical page or VM level instead.
golden_rules.rule2_vt_gatekeeper: VideoToolbox userspace validates ALL video codec parameters before kernel. Any AVE/AVC exploit needs a VT bypass first.
golden_rules.rule3_dart_isolation: GPU VA is hardware-isolated from kernel VA by DART. No GPU→kernel memory access is possible.
golden_rules.rule4_xpc_gates: Hardware accelerator kexts (ANE, DCP, ISP) are behind XPC daemons. Direct IOKit fails with kIOReturnNotPermitted.
golden_rules.rule5_successful_pattern: kfd (PUAF), ClearSword (VFS OOB), WeightBufs (DMA), DarkSword (CoW) — all work at physical/VM/VFS layer ABOVE type isolation. This is the correct approach.
golden_rules.rule6_grow_once: IPC request table grows once then freelist handles everything. No race possible.
golden_rules.rule7_dcp_firmware: IOMFB on A18 Pro is DCP firmware, not kernelcache. Cannot analyze from binary.
